text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
If you're camping on a deserted island, 
does that mean most of your meals revolve 
around fish?

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I often salt-grill, make hot pots, 
or smoke it! It's nice to just gaze out at 
the scenery while idly waiting for the 
smoke to work its magic.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Wah...! That sounds great, 
Heart-san.\nLet's make smoked food during 
our next mountain training!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
That sounds lovely and fun♪ We mustn't 
forget to bring the wood chips.

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Do the two of you always go on mountain 
retreats together?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I often go by myself, but... when I do go 
with someone, I usually end up asking 
Heart-san.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, I've gotten much more 
efficient compared to before.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, the dokudami tea brewed by Heart-san 
has such a deeply soothing flavor!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my! She might say that, but she's 
actually incredibly good at catching 
trout! Just the other day, she caught six 
of them, you know.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
We had it grilled with salt and in soup... 
The weather was wonderful that day, and 
the stars were so beautiful.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah! It was such a wonderful sight, it's 
still burned into my mind."

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
"...Haha! I see, camping out together 
sounds like a blast!"

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
I thought being alone was easier... 
Perhaps next time, I shall try inviting 
someone along as well.
